method: Synthetic independent event/room/kill fixtures from the same original state. Full resulting states match after removing only log text, event outcome wording and enemy label/warning/counterplay strings. All player data, purchases, chest contents, RNG, ID allocation, revision, combat and saved transaction fields compare exactly. No live save or natural progression claim.
